options.name: Saltay Luxe Immersion
options.details_html:
3 Days | 3 Hours Daily

The Way of the Water Being.

Dedicate three consecutive days to a transformative, 9-hour cellular healing odyssey designed to return you to your truest, fluid baseline. The Saltay Luxe Immersion is our most prestigious holistic spa package offering, intuitively tailored to dismantle chronic stress, burnout, and environmental exhaustion. Surrender to the peaceful energy of Hanalei Bay as we guide you into a curated flow of clinical acupuncture, thermal contrast, sculpting touch, and deep restorative medicine. This consecutive master-level sanctuary experience invites your mind, body, and spirit to completely soften, reset, and claim your deepest state of nourishment.
